_context.switch.label: Name of the setting that picks how the workspace is drawn: as the 3D board, or as the Simple view (a list of coworkers beside the chat).
_context.switch.board: The isometric 3D board of the workspace. Keep it short, it labels an icon.
_context.switch.simple: The Simple view of the workspace: a list of coworkers on the left, the chat in the middle. Keep it short, it labels an icon.
_context.list.label: Accessible name of the list of the workspace's coworkers.
_context.list.newBox: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that creates a Box (a group of coworkers) from the list's header.
_context.list.emptyBox: Shown under a Box of the list that holds no coworker yet.
_context.list.boxMore: Accessible name of the '…' button on a Box's header in the list. {name} is the Box's name.
_context.tile.more: Accessible name of the '…' button on a coworker's row. {name} is the coworker's name.
_context.chat.pick: Shown in the middle of the Simple view when no coworker is open.
_context.line.workingOn: Status line under a coworker's name: it is running, {detail} is the title of its conversation or its description.
_context.line.asleepAbout: Status line under a coworker's name: its machine is off, {about} is its description.
_context.line.waiting: Line under a coworker's name in the list, when it waits on the person and its conversation has no title.
_context.foreman.line: Line under the Chief of Staff's name at the top of the list of coworkers: it invites the person to ask it anything.
_context.foreman.card: Tooltip and accessible name of the button at the end of the Chief of Staff's chat bar that opens the column beside it (its name and the workspace's routines). The same button opens a coworker's card: keep the wording of chat.card. {named} is yes once the workspace gave its Chief of Staff (the workspace's AI assistant) a name of its own, {name}; otherwise the default wording is used.
_context.line.you: Line under a coworker's name: the last message of its latest conversation, written by the person reading. {message} is that message, cut to one line.
_context.details.close: Accessible name of the veil behind the coworker's card when it lies over the chat on a narrow window: clicking it closes the card.
_context.details.label: Accessible name of the column showing a coworker's card. {name} is the coworker's name.
_context.phone.section: Accessible name of a collapsible Box header in the phone's list: the Box's name and how many coworkers it holds.
_context.phone.byBox: Option of the phone's list: the coworkers grouped by Box (a group of coworkers) rather than by recency.
_context.foreman.name: {named} is yes once the workspace gave its Chief of Staff (the workspace's AI assistant) a name of its own, {name}; otherwise the default wording is used.
_context.foreman.rename: Accessible label of the name of the Chief of Staff (the workspace's AI assistant) on its card, which an admin clicks to give it a name of their own. Emptying the field gives it back its default name.
_context.checkins.title: Section of the Chief of Staff's card (the workspace's AI assistant) about its check-ins: it wakes up on its own, reads the workspace and writes to someone only when something is worth their time.
_context.checkins.next: {when} is a short relative time such as 'in 3h' or 'now'. The next time the assistant looks at the workspace on its own.
_context.checkins.waiting: Shown when check-ins are on but nobody has written in the workspace yet, so the assistant does not know when someone's day starts.
_context.checkins.unavailable: The server the workspace runs on has check-ins switched off by its operator.
_context.checkins.switchedOff: Tooltip of the disabled Check in now button while check-ins are off.
_context.checkins.reasons.pulse: A line in the list of past check-ins: the daily one found nothing worth saying.
